requestBody.query: Comment accéder à Netflix sur Fibe Tv

200.answer:
You can access Netflix on Fibe TV via your receiver.

- Option 1: Click the APPS or INTERACTIVE TV button on your remote.
- Option 2: Tune to channel 311 or 1311 and click Select or OK.
You can also access Netflix without additional equipment.
